CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_find_duplicates(p_threshold double precision DEFAULT 0.4)
 RETURNS TABLE(test_id_a text, test_name_a text, org_id_a uuid, subtests_count_a bigint, norms_count_a bigint, test_id_b text, test_name_b text, org_id_b uuid, subtests_count_b bigint, norms_count_b bigint, similarity_score double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT check_is_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      a.id AS test_id_a,
      a.name AS test_name_a,
      a.organization_id AS org_id_a,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM official_subtests WHERE test_id = a.id) AS subtests_count_a,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM official_norms n JOIN official_subtests s ON s.id = n.subtest_id WHERE s.test_id = a.id) AS norms_count_a,
      b.id AS test_id_b,
      b.name AS test_name_b,
      b.organization_id AS org_id_b,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM official_subtests WHERE test_id = b.id) AS subtests_count_b,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM official_norms n JOIN official_subtests s ON s.id = n.subtest_id WHERE s.test_id = b.id) AS norms_count_b,
      similarity(norm_name(a.name), norm_name(b.name))::float AS similarity_score
    FROM official_tests a
    CROSS JOIN official_tests b
    WHERE a.id < b.id
      AND similarity(norm_name(a.name), norm_name(b.name)) > p_threshold
    ORDER BY similarity_score DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_test_bundle(p_test_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_bundle jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT check_is_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'test', jsonb_build_object(
        'id', t.id,
        'name', t.name,
        'category_id', t.category_id,
        'version', t.version,
        'author', t.author,
        'organization_id', t.organization_id,
        'created_at', t.created_at
      ),
      'subtests', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', s.id,
          'test_id', s.test_id,
          'name', s.name,
          'unit', s.unit,
          'score_type', s.score_type,
          'computation_mode', s.computation_mode
        ) ORDER BY s.name)
        FROM official_subtests s
        WHERE s.test_id = t.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'norms', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', n.id,
          'subtest_id', n.subtest_id,
          'organization_id', n.organization_id,
          'age_min_months', n.age_min_months,
          'age_max_months', n.age_max_months,
          'gender', n.gender,
          'raw_min', n.raw_min,
          'raw_max', n.raw_max,
          'mean', n.mean,
          'sd', n.sd,
          'standard_score', n.standard_score,
          'percentile', n.percentile
        ) ORDER BY n.age_min_months)
        FROM official_norms n
        WHERE n.subtest_id IN (
          SELECT s2.id FROM official_subtests s2 WHERE s2.test_id = t.id
        )
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    )
  INTO v_bundle
  FROM official_tests t
  WHERE t.id = p_test_id;

  RETURN v_bundle;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_save_test_bundle(p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_test jsonb;
  v_test_id text;
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_subtests jsonb;
  v_norms jsonb;
  v_sub jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT check_is_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_test := COALESCE(p_payload->'test', '{}'::jsonb);
  v_test_id := COALESCE(v_test->>'id', '');

  IF v_test_id = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Test id missing';
  END IF;

  v_org_id := NULL;
  IF (v_test ? 'organization_id') THEN
    v_org_id := NULLIF(v_test->>'organization_id', '')::uuid;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO official_tests (id, name, category_id, version, author, organization_id)
  VALUES (
    v_test_id,
    COALESCE(v_test->>'name', ''),
    COALESCE(v_test->>'category_id', ''),
    COALESCE(v_test->>'version', '1.0'),
    COALESCE(v_test->>'author', ''),
    v_org_id
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    category_id = EXCLUDED.category_id,
    version = EXCLUDED.version,
    author = EXCLUDED.author,
    organization_id = EXCLUDED.organization_id;

  v_subtests := COALESCE(p_payload->'subtests', '[]'::jsonb);
  FOR v_sub IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_subtests)
  LOOP
    IF COALESCE(v_sub->>'id', '') = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Subtest id missing';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO official_subtests (
      id,
      test_id,
      name,
      unit,
      score_type,
      computation_mode
    )
    VALUES (
      v_sub->>'id',
      v_test_id,
      COALESCE(v_sub->>'name', ''),
      COALESCE(v_sub->>'unit', 'pts'),
      COALESCE(v_sub->>'score_type', 'standard'),
      COALESCE(v_sub->>'computation_mode', 'LOOKUP')
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
      test_id = EXCLUDED.test_id,
      name = EXCLUDED.name,
      unit = EXCLUDED.unit,
      score_type = EXCLUDED.score_type,
      computation_mode = EXCLUDED.computation_mode;
  END LOOP;

  -- Replace norms for the provided subtests
  DELETE FROM official_norms
  WHERE subtest_id IN (
    SELECT (s->>'id')::text
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_subtests) s
    WHERE COALESCE(s->>'id', '') <> ''
  );

  v_norms := COALESCE(p_payload->'norms', '[]'::jsonb);
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_norms) > 0 THEN
    INSERT INTO official_norms (
      subtest_id,
      organization_id,
      age_min_months,
      age_max_months,
      gender,
      raw_min,
      raw_max,
      mean,
      sd,
      standard_score,
      percentile
    )
    SELECT
      n->>'subtest_id',
      COALESCE(NULLIF(n->>'organization_id', '')::uuid, v_org_id),
      NULLIF(n->>'age_min_months', '')::integer,
      NULLIF(n->>'age_max_months', '')::integer,
      COALESCE(n->>'gender', 'Mixed'),
      NULLIF(n->>'raw_min', '')::real,
      NULLIF(n->>'raw_max', '')::real,
      NULLIF(n->>'mean', '')::real,
      NULLIF(n->>'sd', '')::real,
      NULLIF(n->>'standard_score', '')::real,
      NULLIF(n->>'percentile', '')::real
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_norms) n
    WHERE COALESCE(n->>'subtest_id', '') <> ''
      AND (n->>'subtest_id') IN (
        SELECT (s->>'id')::text FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_subtests) s
      );
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_private_test_by_name(p_name text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, name text, subtest_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_org_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT organization_id INTO v_org_id
  FROM organization_members
  WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_org_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'No organization found for user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.name,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM official_subtests s WHERE s.test_id = t.id) AS subtest_count
    FROM official_tests t
    WHERE t.organization_id = v_org_id
      AND norm_name(t.name) = norm_name(p_name);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_similar_tests(p_name text, p_threshold double precision DEFAULT 0.3)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, name text, organization_id uuid, similarity_score double precision, subtests_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_norm text;
BEGIN
  -- Get caller's org (NULL if no org, which is fine)
  SELECT om.organization_id INTO v_org_id
  FROM organization_members om
  WHERE om.user_id = auth.uid()
  LIMIT 1;

  v_norm := norm_name(p_name);

  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.name,
      t.organization_id,
      similarity(norm_name(t.name), v_norm)::float AS similarity_score,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM official_subtests s WHERE s.test_id = t.id) AS subtests_count
    FROM official_tests t
    WHERE
      -- Visibility: public OR user's org
      (t.organization_id IS NULL OR t.organization_id = v_org_id)
      -- Fuzzy threshold
      AND similarity(norm_name(t.name), v_norm) > p_threshold
    ORDER BY similarity_score DESC
    LIMIT 10;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_org_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Créer le profil Praticien
  INSERT INTO public.practitioners (id, email, credits, encryption_salt, encryption_validator)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id, 
    NEW.email, 
    3, 
    'pending', 'pending'
  );

  -- 2. Créer l'Organisation par défaut
  INSERT INTO public.organizations (name)
  VALUES ('Cabinet ' || NEW.email)
  RETURNING id INTO new_org_id;

  -- 3. Ajouter le Praticien comme Owner
  INSERT INTO public.organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role, encrypted_org_key)
  VALUES (new_org_id, NEW.id, 'owner', NULL);

  -- 4. Créer l'abonnement Trial (avec date de fin !)
  INSERT INTO public.subscriptions (user_id, plan_id, status, trial_ends_at)
  VALUES (NEW.id, 'free', 'trialing', now() + interval '14 days');

  RETURN NEW;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  -- Log l'erreur mais ne bloque pas la création Auth
  RAISE WARNING 'handle_new_user partial failure for %: %', NEW.id, SQLERRM;
  RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.norm_name(input text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
    SELECT regexp_replace(lower(public.unaccent(trim(COALESCE(input, '')))), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.norm_subtest_name(input text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT lower(public.unaccent(trim(COALESCE(input, '')))) AS v
  ),
  -- Strip MABC-2 prefix
  stripped AS (
    SELECT regexp_replace(v, '^m[^a-z0-9]*abc[^a-z0-9]*2[^a-z0-9]*', '', 'g') AS v FROM base
  ),
  -- Apply synonym replacements and age-qualifier stripping
  cleaned AS (
    SELECT regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
              regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                  regexp_replace(v,
                    E'\\([^)]*(age|ans|mois)[^)]*\\)', ' ', 'gi'),
                  E'\\bage\\s*[0-9].*$', ' ', 'gi'),
                E'\\b(une|un|one)\\b', '1', 'gi'),
              E'\\b(deux|two)\\b', '2', 'gi'),
            E'\\b(trois|three)\\b', '3', 'gi'),
          E'\\b(meilleure)\\b', 'meilleur', 'gi'),
        E'\\b(prefered|preferred|preferee|prefere)\\b', 'prefere', 'gi'),
      E'\\b(meilleur\\s+main|main\\s+meilleur|prefere\\s+main|main\\s+prefere)\\b', '1 main meilleur', 'gi'
    ) AS v FROM stripped
  ),
  -- Tokenize
  tokenized AS (
    SELECT regexp_split_to_table(v, '[^a-z0-9]+') AS token FROM cleaned
  ),
  -- Remove stopwords (aligned with JS SUBTEST_STOPWORDS)
  filtered AS (
    SELECT token FROM tokenized
    WHERE token != ''
      AND token NOT IN ('avec', 'de', 'du', 'des', 'la', 'le', 'les', 'et', 'sur', 'en', 'au', 'aux', 'a', 'mabc', 'mabc2')
  ),
  -- Strip trailing 's' for basic plural handling (length > 3)
  depluralized AS (
    SELECT CASE 
      WHEN length(token) > 3 AND token ~ 's$' THEN left(token, -1)
      ELSE token
    END AS token
    FROM filtered
  )
  SELECT string_agg(token, '' ORDER BY ordinality) 
  FROM (SELECT token, row_number() OVER () AS ordinality FROM depluralized) sub;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_sensitive_updates()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Si l'utilisateur tente de changer ses crédits ou son statut admin via un UPDATE classique
  IF (NEW.credits IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credits) OR (NEW.is_admin IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_admin) THEN
    -- On autorise seulement si c'est un "super admin" ou une fonction serveur (auth.role() = 'service_role')
    -- Mais ici, pour simplifier, on rejette tout update direct venant du contexte utilisateur
    IF auth.uid() = NEW.id THEN 
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Vous ne pouvez pas modifier vos crédits manuellement.';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
